en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a wide view of a town nestled in a river valley, surrounded by hills. The town features clusters of old buildings and streets, with some larger structures visible. The landscape is mountainous and lush. There is a red handwritten number '81' at the top right, and the words 'Gruss aus Bad Ems.' in ornate red font at the bottom. On the left margin, there is the publisher's information: 'Nr. 81. BRUCK & SOHN MEISSEN.'
